refuted: Claim that retroharmonize's S3 class is named 'labelled_spss_survey' extending 'haven::labelled_spss' is CONFIRMED but the claim text says it 'extends haven::labelled_spss' — this is slightly imprecise. The actual class name is 'retroharmonize_labelled_spss' (per rdrr.io source), not just 'labelled_spss_survey'. The benchmark text uses 'labelled_spss_survey S3 class' which is the class name per the dedicated vignette URL title. Both names appear in documentation; no clear refutation but the naming is ambiguous.
Claim that datadictionary has '12 stars, forks: 0' — GitHub search returns 11 stars. Minor discrepancy (1 star difference), not a material error, likely timing difference. Not a fabricated claim.

Claim that pointblank GitHub repo 'moved to https://github.com/posit-dev/pointblank' — REFUTED for the R package. The R package remains at rstudio/pointblank. posit-dev/pointblank is a separate Python package. The rstudio/pointblank R repo has ~1,000 stars and is not redirected. The benchmark correctly notes '(moved to https://github.com/posit-dev/pointblank)' which is inaccurate for the R package.

Claim that codebook 'computes psychometric reliabilities and emits JSON-LD' — both halves verified. Cronbach's alpha specifically: the package computes internal consistencies and other reliabilities but the term 'Cronbach's alpha' does not appear prominently in the public README/tutorial prose (the CRAN README says 'reliabilities (internal consistencies, retest, multilevel)'). The claim is substantively correct even if the exact term is not used in all docs.

summary.overall_assessment: The benchmark's factual claims about package versions, dates, licenses, and features are highly accurate. All six package version/date/license tuples confirmed. validate's GPL-3, YAML support, and cross-dataset comparison confirmed. pointblank's informant YAML round-trip, snip_* functions, and heavy dependency list confirmed. col_vals_in_set() set-as-literal-vector confirmed. codebook's dict_to_list(), JSON-LD export, and psychometric focus confirmed. datadictionary's two-function minimal footprint confirmed. codebookr's Word-output focus confirmed. retroharmonize's S3 class extending haven::labelled_spss confirmed. One claim needs correction: the rstudio/pointblank R package has NOT moved to posit-dev/pointblank; that URL hosts a separate Python package.
summary.correction_needed: In the benchmark text, the pointblank GitHub URL annotation '(moved to https://github.com/posit-dev/pointblank)' is incorrect for the R package. The R package is at https://github.com/rstudio/pointblank and has not been redirected. posit-dev/pointblank is an independent Python port.
summary.licence_note: GPL-2+ is compatible with GPL-3 when '+' means 'or later'. The validate dependency risk in the benchmark is correctly flagged as needing verification; the 'if ambiguous, imitate' advice is sound.
